description: One functional pin group on a chip record. A pin-group map is a functional description, NOT a fabrication pinout: no per-net layout assignments, no package ball map. Per-pin IDs, direction, and voltage domain are carried per group; full per-pin netlists exist only where real EDA artifacts exist (none for seeded archive designs).

count.description: Number of pins in this group (design target).

direction.description: Signal direction for the group: in, out, in/out, or n/a.

not_fabrication_pinout.description: Must be true: this is not a fabrication-ready pinout.

title: Pin Group
